:::{#sol-prac-exp-mle-second-derivative .solution}

The [second derivative](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mds/calculus-derivatives.html#def-second-derivative) is:

$$
\ba
\hess(\pmean; \vx)
&= \deriv{\pmean}\paren{-\frac{n}{\pmean} + \frac{n\bar{x}}{\pmean^2}}
\\
&= \frac{n}{\pmean^2} - \frac{2n\bar{x}}{\pmean^3}
\ea
$$

:::
